Help and about
Frequently asked questions
Why are my photos out of order in other apps?
Instagram shows photos in the order they arrived on the phone, and KakaoTalk in the order the files last changed. Moving photos all at once scrambles that order.
How does the app work?
Like slipping prints back into an album in the order they were taken. The app finds each real date, then re-saves only the out-of-order photos, oldest first.
Will my photos lose quality or change?
No. Each copy is identical to the original.
What happens to the originals?
They stay in the trash for 30 days, and you can undo from the first screen until then.
I restored photos from the Gallery trash and now each one shows twice
Restoring from the trash by hand leaves both the copy and the original. Use \"Undo\" on the first screen instead. If it already happened, delete the restored photos again.
How much free space do I need?
About as much as the photos being fixed, for a short while. The scan screen shows it.
Will Google Photos or other cloud backups get duplicates?
No. Copies are identical, so they count as the same photos. If some show twice, turn the Gallery\'s sync off and on.
The app says nothing needs fixing, but an app still shows the wrong order
Restart that app. If the scan offers \"Fix file times\", tap it.
Photos I cropped or edited on the iPhone look unedited
Edits don\'t move to the new phone. Download the edited photos from icloud.com.
Are my photos sent anywhere?
No. The app has no internet permission, so it can\'t send anything. No ads, no account.
